findings: _persist_runtime_phase_launch_receipt recorded receipt in state reservations under _measured_runtime_state_lock without atomically writing current['workers'][run_id] and queue_status(current, q_evt_id) fields ('run_id', 'lease_owner', 'status').
In process_queue(), active worker matching did not evaluate record.get('lease_owner') != active_run_id, preventing repair of started events missing lease_owner.
In process_queue(), started/manual_pending events with missing lease_owner were skipped early on record.get('status') in {'started', 'manual_pending'}, bypassing active_worker resolution and repair.
In promote_supervisor_runtime.py, worker_lease_parity_and_no_duplicates evaluated missing_lease_owner on unstarted queued/pending queue events.

remediation.atomic_publication: Updated _persist_runtime_phase_launch_receipt and start_worker_for_request to atomically bind worker records and queue event lease_owner, run_id, and status fields under _measured_runtime_state_lock.
remediation.repair_mechanism: Updated process_queue active_worker matching and skip conditions to detect and repair missing or mismatched lease_owner on started/manual_pending events.
remediation.promotion_invariant: Updated promote_supervisor_runtime.py worker_lease_parity_and_no_duplicates to exempt unstarted queued/pending events while remaining fail-closed for started/in-flight events.
